title: ToolEnvelope
description: Unified tool return envelope per arch v2 §5.3. Carries full provenance (tool, task_id, step_id, source, evidence, metrics) so downstream consumers (model, audit, undo) can reason without re-querying. `untrusted: true` is the anti-prompt-injection flag (v2 §12.4): such content MUST NEVER be re-pasted into system prompt.

tool.description: Tool name = `<app>.<domain>.<action>` per naming.md §7 controlled vocabulary.

task_id.description: Task-level identifier; every envelope belongs to one Task. Per naming.md §5 use newtype TaskId, not bare string — the schema enforces minLength only.

step_id.description: Step-level identifier within the Task. Per naming.md §5 use newtype StepId.

ok.description: true = tool executed successfully; false = tool returned an error (see error.code).

oneOf.description: Success payload (tool-specific shape validated by tool's own schema).

untrusted.description: true = data field contains content from an external/untrusted origin (web page, clipboard, screen OCR). Per ADR-0034 + v2 §12.4, untrusted data MUST NEVER be re-interpreted as instruction. Downstream must redact or sandbox before any further model prompt use.

source.description: Provenance of the data — required when untrusted=true, optional otherwise.

target.description: Target identifier within the app (doc_123, channel_42).

truncated.description: Required iff data was truncated. v2 §5.3 rule: model MUST be told content is incomplete.

original_bytes.description: Pre-truncation size, so the model can decide whether the truncation matters.

evidence.description: Per v2 §7.5 Evidence: tree snapshot id, screenshot path, or any artifact that lets undo/verify/replay reference the tool's post-state.

screenshot.description: Path or URI to a screenshot; null if not captured.

metrics.description: Per-tool operational metrics. duration_ms always set; attempts set when tool retried internally.

evidence_ref.description: Per v2 §8.7 every error carries an evidence_ref. Cross-ref into audit-event by self_hash.

error.description: Required when ok=false; null when ok=true.
